workflow.entry: Use the existing science plan, admission and supervised worker; this fragment does not add a launch path.
workflow.output: Supply {filename: a safe basename, format: json or json-compact}.
workflow.inputs: Reference local regular files; input discovery pins every referenced bundle and correlation table.
workflow.closure: Supply independent held-out rate values, uncertainties and tolerance; runtime closure uses the shared polynomial comparator.
workflow.scope: Conditional on supplied rate mappings and correlations; physics validity and global optimizer qualification remain independent.

handoffs.shared_registration: Compose operation signatures, mode descriptors and manifest rows; bind the adapter through the existing science adapter resolver and named checks through the review check resolver.
handoffs.workflow_embedding: Embed task fields and supported treatments in the supplied-data workflow at registry composition; preserve scientific admission and regenerate the instruction bundle there.
handoffs.reference_tables: reference_branching_fractions(table, decay_rows, mass_gev=...) accepts supplied exact reference row identities. Version-two coefficient ingestion remains with the reference table producer.
handoffs.fit_consumers: fit(measurements, parameterization, treatment=..., scans=..., predictor=...) exposes the in-process prediction seam. The callable returns a finite vector in measurement row order; callers qualify their own prediction closure.
handoffs.directory: Map the new physics modules and validation module as software, schemas/fragments as data and synthetic fixtures/tests as software/data at composition.
